issues.legal_issue: The disposal of surplus land acquired for a public purpose must serve a public purpose or, if no other public purpose requires the land, be made through a public auction rather than by preferential sale to the former owners.
material_facts: Land was acquired for construction of a national highway, and the construction was completed.
Only part of the acquired land was used; the balance remained unused.
The Government proposed selling the unused land to a former owner at the rate at which compensation had been awarded.
The High Court held the executive order authorising the proposed sale invalid because it contravened the applicable land-assignment law.
issues.conclusion: The executive order was invalid, and the appeal was dismissed. Any assignment of the land had to serve a public purpose; if the land was not needed for another public purpose, it should be sold through public auction rather than to the former owner at the compensation rate.
issues.legal_principle: Land acquired under the Land Acquisition Act vests in the State free from encumbrances. Once the purpose for which it was acquired has been achieved, the State may use the remaining land for another purpose. If no other public purpose requires it, the land should be sold by public auction so that the public may obtain the benefit of the higher value; assignment must be for a public purpose. The executive order in this case was invalid because it was not consonant with the Kerala Land Assignment Act, 1960 (Act 30 of 1960). Section 11 is mentioned as the basis for the compensation rate, but no earlier cases are cited.

rule.if: appeal_challenges_invalid_executive_disposal_order and land_acquired_for_public_purpose and acquisition_purpose_completed and acquired_land_partly_unused and proposed_sale_to_former_owner_at_compensation_rate and executive_order_conflicts_with_land_assignment_law and no_other_public_purpose_requires_land

predicates.appeal_challenges_invalid_executive_disp: An appeal challenges a ruling that invalidated an executive order for disposing of government land.
predicates.land_acquired_for_public_purpose: The land was acquired by the State for a public purpose.
predicates.acquisition_purpose_completed: The public project for which the land was acquired was completed.
predicates.acquired_land_partly_unused: Part of the acquired land remained unused after the project was completed.
predicates.proposed_sale_to_former_owner_at_compens: The State proposed selling the unused land to a former owner at the rate used to calculate acquisition compensation.
predicates.executive_order_conflicts_with_land_assi: The executive order authorising the disposal was inconsistent with the applicable law governing assignment of land.
predicates.no_other_public_purpose_requires_land: The land was not required for another public purpose.

issues.definition: When an appeal concerns an invalid executive disposal order, and the acquired project is complete with land left unused, a proposed compensation-rate sale to a former owner under an order inconsistent with land-assignment law requires a public auction if no other public purpose requires the land.
